definitionZh: 边框-图像切片 CSS 属性将边框-图像源指定的图像划分为区域. 这些地区构成了元素边框图像的组成部分.
sourceDefinition: The border-image-slice CSS property divides the image specified by border-image-source into regions. These regions form the components of an element's border image.

sourceEvidence.sourceDefinition: The border-image-slice CSS property divides the image specified by border-image-source into regions. These regions form the components of an element's border image.
